title: Structured perturbations of tridiagonal twisted Toeplitz matrices
summary: Twisted Toeplitz matrices constitute a generalization of Toeplitz matrices in the sense that the entries on each diagonal no longer need to be constant, but are given by the values of a continuous function on a partition of $[0,1]$. We study the limiting statistical distribution of the eigenvalues of matrices of the form $R_n(a) = T_n(a) + σ_n X_n$, where $T_n(a)$ is a sequence of non-Hermitian tridiagonal twisted Toeplitz matrices, $X_n$ is a sequence of tridiagonal random matrices whose entries have mean $0$ and finite variance, and $σ_n\to0$.
